description: Document comments: who may read and add, text limits.

preconditions: Meeting Published; actor "An" is a Member; M1 is a PDF with 10 pages in the meeting.
cases.inputs: body: "Đề nghị bổ sung số liệu quý 3."; pageNumber: 4; parentCommentId: null.
cases.return: Success; comment returned with body, page 4, author An, no replies; endpoint answers MSG199.
cases.log: DocumentComment row saved with AuthorId An, PageNumber 4, CreatedAt = now; a share lock taken on the meeting row.

preconditions: Same document.
cases.return: Failure Blank (HTTP 400, MSG200); nothing is read from the database.

preconditions: Same document.
cases.return: Failure Blank (HTTP 400, MSG200).

preconditions: Same document.
cases.return: Success; the comment is saved with all 4,000 characters.

preconditions: Same document.
cases.return: Failure TooLong (HTTP 400, MSG348).

preconditions: Same document.
cases.inputs: body: 4,000 characters of "a" surrounded by 5 spaces on each side.
cases.return: Success; the body is trimmed before the length check so it is 4,000 characters.

preconditions: Actor cannot read the meeting (not a participant).
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: Meeting does not exist.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: M1 was removed from the meeting.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: M3 is attached only to a draft vote; actor is a Member.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: Same draft-vote document; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Success; managers see draft-vote documents.

preconditions: Meeting Ended.
cases.return: Failure Ended (HTTP 409, MSG251); comments are read-only after the meeting ends.

preconditions: Meeting Cancelled (it had been Published, so participants can still open it).
cases.return: Failure Cancelled (HTTP 409, MSG349).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; thread T1 (top-level comment) exists on M1.
cases.return: Success; reply attached to T1, page number dropped (null) because a reply has no page.

preconditions: R1 is a reply to T1.
cases.return: Success; the new comment joins thread T1 (ParentCommentId = T1), one level deep.
cases.log: DocumentComment row with ParentCommentId = T1, not R1.

preconditions: Comment C9 belongs to another document.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: M1 is a PDF with 10 pages.
cases.return: Success; page 10 kept (last page).

preconditions: M1 is a PDF with 10 pages.
cases.return: Success; comment saved without a page (null).

preconditions: M1 is a PDF with 10 pages.
cases.return: Success; page dropped (null) because pages start at 1.

preconditions: M1 is a PDF whose page count is unknown (null).
cases.return: Success; page 50 kept as the document has no known limit.

preconditions: M2 is a DOCX.
cases.return: Success; page dropped (null) because only PDF comments carry a page.

preconditions: Meeting Published; actor is a verified guest with a current session of this meeting, invitation I1, display name "Khách A".
cases.return: Success; author shown as a guest named "Khách A"; endpoint answers MSG199.
cases.log: DocumentComment row with GuestInvitationId I1 and no AuthorId; a share lock taken on the guest session row.

preconditions: Guest whose session has been signed out or has expired.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: Guest whose invitation was revoked.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156); rechecked on every call.

preconditions: Guest of meeting X posting to meeting Y.
cases.inputs: actor: Guest of X; meetingId: Y.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156).

preconditions: Guest session valid but the meeting is Ended.
cases.return: Failure NotFound (HTTP 404, MSG156), not MSG251: the guest has lost the meeting altogether.

preconditions: Database error while saving.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed (HTTP 503, MSG202); no comment is saved.
cases.log: Error log "Failed to save a comment on document".
